description: Set f.lux's Bedtime (Night) color temperature to 1900K (Candle). The Bedtime temperature slider is visible in the f.lux preferences window. The pref key that controls this setting is NOT documented in the task — you must discover its name by probing ~/Library/Preferences/org.herf.Flux.plist before and after making a test UI change, or by reading defaults output. Once you know the key, set it to integer 1900. Any write method is accepted (GUI slider, defaults write, PlistBuddy) as long as the final plist reflects the target value. Do not alter wakeTime, Sparkle update settings, or location keys.
natural_language: Set f.lux Bedtime color temperature to 1900K (Candle). The pref key name is unknown — discover it by probing the plist, then write 1900.
